en: A fireman usually helps people put out the fire.
zh: 消防员通常帮助人们把火扑灭。

zh: 那支乐队是第一支在鸟巢演出的摇滚乐队。

en: From the very first, we knew the project would be a success.
zh: 从一开始，我们就知道这个项目会成功。

zh: 达明教他的孙子如何能捕到更多的鱼。
rewrite: = Damin taught his grandsons how to catch more fish.

en: She sings beautifully, and she can dance as well.
Miss Wu is our class teacher and our friend as well.
zh: 吴小姐不仅是我们的老师，还是我们的朋友。
rewrite: = Miss Wu is not only our class teacher but also our friend.

en: I'll ask for your help if I can't work out the problem.
zh: 如果我解不出这题，我会请你帮忙。

en: When playing basketball, we can enjoy the sunshine and fresh air at the same time.
zh: 打篮球时，我们可以同时享受阳光和新鲜的空气。
